hero.headline: Uteytithya Nuon
hero.subtitle: Backend Developer — the strength beneath the floor
hero.body: A backend developer drawn to the part nobody sees — the services, schemas, and pipelines everything else stands on. Laravel and Nuxt on the web, Flutter on mobile, machine learning when the problem asks for it. Built to hold.

about.title: About
about.body1: I'm Uteytithya Nuon, a developer from Phnom Penh — studying Computer Science with a focus on Software Engineering at the Cambodia Academy of Digital Technology, and building things end to end: secure Laravel backends, Nuxt frontends, Flutter apps, and ML pipelines with TensorFlow and scikit-learn.
about.body2: From NLP document processing at InternLink to quantum ML research and Robocon robotics, my approach stays the same: remove until nothing remains but what is essential — then make it fast, and make it hold.
about.quote: 静けさの中に力がある

work.title: Selected Work
work.description: Selected backend, machine learning, and mobile projects by Uteytithya Nuon — case studies with the stack and the reasoning behind each.

items.body: Built the AI-facing backend for a scholarship platform — a graph database modelling how scholarships, eligibility rules, and student profiles relate, so the system can match a student to what they actually qualify for. Added a double-entry ledger attributing every AI API call to a user and session, and MCP tools that give agents sandboxed, permissioned access to internal data.

Built the CV understanding service — an ensemble of LayoutLM models that reads a resume by its layout, not just its text, classifying candidates across five developer and data roles. Shipped as a containerized FastAPI service with confidence scores on every prediction, and a caching layer that halved the load time for processed results.

Built a quantum-assisted model for predicting protein folds, tested against simulated quantum devices. Tuned the circuit parameters for stability and accuracy, then measured the hybrid quantum–classical approach against classical baselines.

Built and maintained the RESTful services behind class scheduling and report generation — the endpoints carrying the school's daily operations. Refactored data fetching onto server-side caching, cutting page load latency in half.

Built the real-time link between robot and control computer — a high-speed communication system for live control during runs. Worked close to the metal in embedded C/C++, wiring sensor integration and device control across the platform.
